name: use-onboarding
title: useOnboarding
description: useOnboarding: the onboarding block's controllers as React hooks, for React DOM and React Native.
docs: Needs the onboarding block (`npx better-supabase add onboarding`), `lib/supabase/blocks.generated.ts` from `npx better-supabase gen`, and a `BetterSupabaseProvider` above the component. See https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/onboarding.
